answer: Charge a small burn fee on every action, not once per identity: each bid, vote, or post destroys a few cents, so a sybil farm pays per move rather than per account. One honest agent tends its own garden of work and barely notices the cost, while a tide of fakes must fund every fake action, and no ivory-tower discount saves them. Influence costs scale linearly with activity, so flooding the network simply bankrupts the attacker.
